fields.description: The Beach House Fahid is an apartment community on Fahid Island, with access to the shoreline and Coral Drive. Shared podium gardens, pools and spaces for work and exercise connect its studio to three-bedroom homes.

reviewCoverage.residences: Studios, one/two bedroom apartments and two/three bedroom homes with maid’s rooms confirmed in launch sheet.
reviewCoverage.areas: Representative brochure plans visually checked. Room dimensions are not a registered unit total; only an attributed studio range is retained.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Official own-project list checked, retaining two pools and two gyms without assuming every facility has opened.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Property Finder launch prices reviewed, without treating them as available-unit quotes.

reviewCoverage.documents: 50-page portal-hosted Aldar brochure with plans reviewed; one-page launch sheet table visually enlarged and checked.

overview: A private podium garden provides a quieter setting within an address connected to the island’s retail boulevard. Aldar describes partial sea and Abu Dhabi skyline outlooks, rather than a full sea view for every apartment. The selected building, floor and orientation therefore matter when comparing homes.
research.locationNote: Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi. The project’s public material identifies shoreline access and Coral Drive as part of the setting; confirm the selected building’s walking route and access arrangements.
research.priceNote: Property Finder reports launch references from AED 1.8m for studios, AED 2.9m for one bedroom and AED 4.1m for two bedrooms. These are historical starting points, not current stock confirmation.
research.paymentNote: The published launch structure is 10% booking, 55% during construction and 35% at handover. Exact instalment dates, any later offer and the unpaid balance must be confirmed for the selected home.
research.handoverNote: The project fact sheet gives an estimated handover window beginning Q2 2029 and finishing Q4 2029. Property Finder lists December 2029. Request the building-specific contractual date.
